haikus.haiku:
Cart glows with bright hope
Shoppers laugh, bags dance, bright noon
Toys sparkle, joy sings
Happy #ShoppingReminderDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden leaves drift soft
Pumpkin scent fills deep warm halls
Crows call, night settles
Happy #ThanksgivingDay from @ClamBakeSanta

Bubbles lift, bright up
Cartoon clouds drift over town
Joyful laughter rings
#HappyBirthdayCharlesSchulz from @ClamBakeSanta

Golden lights dance soft
Swaying rhythms fill the air
Vibrant cheers rise high
#HappyBirthdayTinaTurner from @ClamBakeSanta
